title: Docker Nginx Sandbox
scenario: Before shipping AWS challenges to a live judge, you must prove the workflow on a zero-cost local sandbox. Using the Docker provider, provision an Nginx container that publishes port 80 on a configurable host port, restarts unless stopped, and carries operational labels. This challenge can be applied and destroyed against your local Docker daemon — no cloud bill.
constraints: Docker provider host must reference var.docker_host (default: npipe:////./pipe/docker_engine).
container_name must be a validated lowercase/hyphen string.
host_port must be a number defaulting to 8080 with validation 1024–65535.
The container must publish internal port 80 on var.host_port.
privileged must be false; mounting docker.sock and host networking are blocked.
Container must carry labels: Project, Environment, ManagedBy = "terraform".
Outputs must expose container_id, container_name and url.
